questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A sentence can't end with **the **or **and**. Thus, neither P nor Q can be last => Option 3) ***PQR** *is the correct answer.

**The correct sentence is-***** **Attaining long term food security requires the raising of incomes and making food affordable.*

questions.question:
A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice. 

The Chinese company manufactured those robots.

options.text: Those robots were manufactured by the Chinese company.
Those robots was manufacture by the Chinese company.
These robots were manufactured by the Chinese company.
The robots was manufactured by the Chinese company.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'Those robots were manufactured by the Chinese company.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given question the sentence **'The Chinese company manufactured those robots.' **is in **'Active voice'** which is in the **past indefinite** and we know that after converted this sentence into **'Passive voice'** the tense will same which also should in **past indefinite**.

 
 
• **Struture Past indefinite:**

 
 
• Sub + V2 + object ***(Active)***
 
• Object + was/were+ V3 + by + subject ***(Passive)***
 
 
 
• **Let's see the example:**
 
 
• Reema cleaned the floor ***(Active)***
 
• The floor was cleaned by Reema ***(Passive)***
 
 
 
 

**Hence the correct sentence is-** *Those robots were manufactured by the Chinese company. *

**The correct sentence is- ***Bunty said that he might not come for the practice that day. *
